search_text: published ZDI-07-079 ZDI-CAN-201 Hewlett-Packard HP-UX swagentd Buffer Overflow Vulnerability 2007-12-17 CVE-2007-6195 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2007-6195 ['Hewlett-Packard'] ['HP-UX'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Hewlett-Packard HP-UX operating system. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the function sw_rpc_agent_init (opcode 0x04) defined in swagentd. Specific malformed arguments can cause function pointers to be overwritten and thereby result in arbitrary code execution. Hewlett-Packard has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found in HP document ID #SB2294r1.
